get.description: Discover and query all active loan products enabled for your partner API key (Personal Loan, Pocket Loan, Business Loan, Gold Loan).

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Your active EASYCRED Partner API Key (format: ec_live_... or ec_test_...)

parameters.name: x-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix epoch seconds. Requests outside the 5-minute tolerance window are rejected.

parameters.name: x-nonce
parameters.description: Unique UUID v4 nonce per request to prevent replay attacks.

parameters.name: x-signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over method, path, timestamp, nonce, and raw request body.

400.description: Bad Request - Validation or payload failure

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API key, signature mismatch, or replayed nonce

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions or unassigned product scope

404.description: Not Found - The requested resource or application does not exist

429.description: Rate Limit Exceeded - Too many requests in short interval
